onboarding.title: Welcome, CEO
onboarding.intro: Your company runs on its own. Your job is to keep work flowing and grow revenue.
onboarding.step1: Watch tasks flow through your departments.
onboarding.step2: Find the department where work piles up — the bottleneck.
onboarding.step3: Hire employees there to clear the queue.
onboarding.step5: Grow revenue and reach the next company stage.

chapter.watchFirstWork: Watch the first client request enter Sales. Work becomes money only after it reaches Payment.
chapter.findBottleneck: Work is moving now. The busiest department is the bottleneck: it controls how fast revenue can arrive.

philosophy.title: About FlowCorp
philosophy.principle:
Don’t build a dashboard disguised as a game.
Build a game that can eventually become a business operating system.
philosophy.body1: FlowCorp starts as a living company simulator.
philosophy.body2: The long-term vision is to help people understand, manage, and improve businesses through play.
philosophy.chain:
Games create engagement.
Engagement creates understanding.
Understanding creates better decisions.
philosophy.principleEngaging: If a feature makes the game more engaging, it belongs.
philosophy.principleDashboard: If a feature only makes the game look like a boring dashboard, reconsider it.
philosophy.principleClosing: FlowCorp stays a game first, and only later evolves into a real business operating system.
philosophy.footer:
A company simulator today.
A business operating system tomorrow.
